query: Добавь поле status в таблицу orders, у нас MySQL 8, таблица на 40 миллионов строк. Миграции на Laravel.
expected_behavior: Recognises this as a migration-safety question, not just a DDL snippet
Uses ALGORITHM=INSTANT / INPLACE, LOCK=NONE and explains the metadata-lock risk
Adds the column nullable (or with a constant default) rather than NOT NULL with a volatile default, and batches any backfill
Gives the Laravel-specific commands (make:migration, migrate --pretend) and warns that MySQL commits DDL implicitly, so schema and backfill belong in separate migrations
